name: rating-filter
title: Rating filter
description: '4 stars and up' as a filter: a radio list of star rows with the number of products beside each and an Any rating choice.
docs: value is the lowest rating that passes, or null for any rating; control it with value and onValueChange or start it with defaultValue. options are the ratings to offer, from the highest (4, 3, 2 and 1 by default) and max is how many stars a rating has. counts is { any, 4, 3, 2, 1 }: how many products each choice leaves, cumulative, and optional; without it no counts are shown. It is a radio group, so arrow keys choose and Tab leaves; the stars are decoration and a row is named in words, '4 stars and up, 128 products'. A row whose count is 0 is disabled and reads '0 products'. The chosen row is bold with a check, never only coloured stars, and every row is 44px tall. locale writes the counts and labels holds the fixed words.
